title: Commuting Division-Coefficient Forms and the Artinian Eisenbud--Green--Harris Conjecture
summary: We prove the Eisenbud–Green–Harris conjecture over every characteristic-zero field for homogeneous regular sequences of any positive length, with degrees at least two. Thus every homogeneous ideal containing such a sequence has the Hilbert function of a monomial ideal containing the corresponding pure powers.

review.reason: Proves the Eisenbud-Green-Harris conjecture for homogeneous regular sequences in characteristic zero.
